identitySignals: The agenda item is a collective bargaining agreement between OUSD and AFSCME for July 1, 2024 through June 30, 2027, which is a labor union contract, not a vendor purchase
OUSD's Labor & Employee Relations page lists AFSCME (American Federation of State, County and Municipal Employees) as one of its bargaining units
afscme57.org lists AFSCME Local 257 (a local of AFSCME Council 57, Oakland, CA) as the local representing Oakland Unified School District employees
No local numbered exactly '57' was found; 'Local 57' in the agenda may be a shortening of Local 257 or Council 57, so the exact entity is uncertain

profile.summary: AFSCME Council 57 is a labor union based in Oakland, California. It was established in 1963 and is made up of 26 local unions with about 35,000 members in Northern California and the Central Valley. Its members work in schools, community colleges, transit agencies, public services and health care. It does organizing, collective bargaining and political action.
